files.patch:
@@ -167,10 +167,10 @@ jobs:
           REWRITE_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.rewrite_commit }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
-          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
             echo "Refusing to modify existing release $TAG" >&2
             exit 1
           fi
-          gh release create "$TAG" release/* \
+          gh release create "$TAG" release/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
             --title "$TAG" \
-            --notes "Built from wstein/flix-fork@$FLIX_COMMIT and wstein/rewrite-fork@$REWRITE_COMMIT on Linux AMD64 and Intel macOS."
+            --notes "Built from wstein/flix-fork@$FLIX_COMMIT and wstein/rewrite-fork@$REWRITE_COMMIT on Linux AMD64, Linux ARM64, and Apple Silicon macOS."
